bounds.domain: Two one-shot dispatches in one phase. There is one mutator, two ordered serial readers and two concurrent readers. One serial reader can be replaced once and the other can be removed once.
bounds.limitations: The selected target represents a hook that may succeed, produce an ordinary diagnostic or, in the grouped pre_model case only, reject local text admission under the source provider, model and error predicate. A hook's completion includes any awaited metrics observer; payloads, timing, independent observer errors, phase moves, skip flags, outbound guards and shutdown are outside this projection. The real runtime fixture covers the grouped snapshot schedule and ordinary diagnostic.

assumptions: No fairness assumption. Admission takes the current registry and later writes preserve that dispatch's selected handler identities.
Each dispatch's progress action is weakly fair. Its handlers and awaited diagnostic observers eventually settle.
No fairness assumption. An admitted dispatch can remain pending when a handler or observer never settles.
